system.description:
Shamans and spirit-talkers who walk between the material world and the spirit realms.

Affiliation: Traditions
Affinity Spheres: Spirit; Forces, Life, or Matter
system.focus: Magick is a partnership with spirits and the living world. Through ritual, trance, offerings and respect for the Umbra, Dreamspeakers broker pacts with spirits and tend the balance between the seen and unseen.
